items.reason: A mild 2.5% benzoyl peroxide wash is a gentle, age-appropriate way to help keep the chin and jaw looking clearer.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable skin barrier, which helps with the lower moisture reading and any dryness from the wash.
A mineral SPF 50 protects skin every morning and is gentle on young skin.

response.routine_note: Start with the wash once a day in the evening and rinse well, then moisturize, and use the SPF each morning. If the spots are painful, leave marks or don't improve after a couple of months, a dermatologist or doctor is the best next step.
